title: Police Stop: No License, Registration, Insurance, Plates SUCCESS! Right To Travel - Paul Unslaved
summary: Promoter films a Colorado stop with no licence, plates or insurance, arguing private travel is not commercial driving, and celebrates being released without a citation.

assertions.quote: I don't need a license registration or any documentation to travel from point A to point B
driving is doing Commerce on the roadway I am not doing Commerce
the Supreme Court has ruled that I do not need to register license or any of that unless I'm doing Commerce on the roadways
no license no registration no insurance no nothing because I don't need any of that to travel from point A to point B
once I provide any kind of information I'm Contracting with him and I would rather not contract

verdicts.note: Identifying yourself to police forms no contract; police authority comes from statute, not agreement.

assertions.quote: the purpose of those lights are emergency lights they're not for pulling people over
all they had to do was be given a number and a secondary name
